reviews.title: Too many Ads
reviews.text: Regret to say that it starts with ad, pictures, female pictures which is a hurdle before reciting Quran.

reviews.title: Ads
reviews.text: I’ve been using this app for almost 9 years, but when I opened it recently, I was disappointed to find ads popping up one after another. I think it’s time to say goodbye. I wouldn’t recommend this app anymore. I’ve switched to Al Quran instead. It’s disappointing to see an app I’ve used and trusted for so many years become so full of ads.
